notes: First-contact visibility on Hermes: after one trivial `hermes chat` turn the dashboard must show the model and a non-zero context utilization, over ready→working→ready. Hermes writes NO transcript file — the daemon reads one shared SQLite store at $HERMES_HOME/state.db (ProcessOwnedStore): metrics.model_name comes from sessions.model, TotalTokens from the sessions input+output aggregate, and context_window/context_utilization from ComputeContextUtilization(model, tokens, cm, 0) — verified resolvable because the live boot model gpt-5.6-luna carries context_window=1050000 in the capacity cache (first-turn ~16.3k tokens ≈ 1.55%). The arc is driven by explicit signals, not idle timing: Hermes persists the inbound user row BEFORE the first LLM call (agent/turn_context.py) and bumps sessions.message_count in the same write → non-terminal activity → working; the assistant row with finish_reason='stop' → terminal activity → ready. BIRTH: the sessions row is INSERTed only on the first user message, so the sub-second ready birth is carried by the transient proc-<PID> pre-session the scanner mints; session_birth is anchored to start UNPINNED and turn_end chains off turn_start (never off session_birth) so the presession cannot steal identity — same shape as the hermes 1-1/2-1 siblings. NO metric hard-assertion is pinned: of verify reads only the replay golden summary, and for hermes that golden can carry none of these metrics — the #766 store-vector lift (total_tokens/context_window/context_utilization_percentage) is gated to antigravity at cmd/replay/metrics.go:59, and cum tokens/cost/model in the golden come from the transcript replay while hermes' values are computed by ComputeMetrics over the store (the hermes Parser emits no token/cost fields). Same shape as opencode's 1.8 golden, which carries no model/cost/token keys at all. The three acceptance metrics are therefore checked on the LIVE metrics surface at record time (see the cell recipe's verify[]); record may pin observations.model (live default: gpt-5.6-luna, env-dependent per #440) once it sees what the recording actually carries. Unlock for full verify coverage: extend the #766 lift + store staging to hermes as was done for antigravity.

text: A hermes session appears in ready shortly after launch (the transient proc-<PID> pre-session carries the sub-second birth; the store-backed <YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>_<hex> session lands once the first user message is persisted). Nothing ever enters waiting — one no-tool turn.
A PID is bound to the session (hermes is a Python console script, matched on the full command line)
The trivial user prompt drives the store-backed session ready → working (user row persisted before the LLM call, message_count grows, newest row is not an assistant/stop row)

The turn completes back to ready on the same session (assistant row with finish_reason='stop' → turn_done). AFTER this point the live metrics surface must show model_name non-empty and not 'unknown', context_window > 0 and context_utilization_percentage > 0 — asserted at the metrics tier, not in this phase DSL (events.jsonl carries no metric fields).
